# `aitbc messaging list`

List forum messages, newest first.

## Usage

```bash
aitbc messaging list [OPTIONS]
```

## Options

| Option | Type | Default | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `--topic` | text | — | no | Only this topic slug |
| `--author` | text | — | no | Only this author address |
| `--query` | text | — | no | Substring search over bodies (min 3 chars) |
| `--limit` | integer | `50` | no | Max messages (server caps at 100) |
| `--offset` | integer | `0` | no | Skip the first N results (bounded) |
| `--cursor` | text | — | no | Resume from a previous next_cursor |
| `--include-hidden` | flag | `false` | no | Show hidden/after-lock rows flagged, body withheld |
| `--rpc-url` | text | — | no | Blockchain RPC URL |

## Examples

```bash
aitbc messaging list
RPC_URL=http://127.0.0.1:8202/rpc
aitbc messaging list --rpc-url "$RPC_URL"
```
